Q001.cannot: No record captures shoppers who entered the store but did not buy 5 kg atta. The data only records sales of the eleven followed items (daily-sales-june, pos-lines-may-june) and payment attempts (pos-payments-june). There is no footfall count, no shopper identity, and no record of a shopper's intent or a product not purchased.

Closing book stock for 5 kg atta (ATTA-WW-5KG) each day in June 2026; book stock is a belief, not the shelf, and lost sales are not recorded.
Shelf audit status (on shelf/empty) for 5 kg atta at 11:00 on Tuesdays and Fridays in June 2026; audits are snapshots, not hours off shelf, and lost sales are not recorded.

Q003.cannot: True demand (sales if never out of stock) is not recorded. The records hold only actual sales (daily-sales-june) and 11:00 shelf-audit snapshots (shelf-audits-june). Lost sales while the shelf was empty are not recorded, and there is no continuous shelf-availability measure to estimate them.

Q004.cannot: Substitution is not recorded. No table links a shopper who found toned milk empty to another product they bought. Shelf audits show when MILK-TONED-500ML was empty at 11:00, but there is no record of what the same shopper chose instead. Bills and till lines have no shopper identity, and no table records a lost sale or a switch.

Q005.cannot: No table records shopper visits or unique people. Bills (pos-payments-june) are the nearest stand-in but a bill is not a person.

Q006.cannot: No record captures a shopper who started a basket and left without paying. pos-payments-june records payment attempts per bill, but a bill is created only after items are scanned and the shopper proceeds to pay; there is no table of started-but-unpaid baskets, no shopper identity, and no event for 'abandoned at till'. The nearest stand-in is a bill (one bill ≈ one checkout), but that only covers completed transactions.

Q007.cannot: No table identifies a customer or links bills to a shopper. A bill is the nearest stand-in, but the question asks for customers.

Q008.cannot: No customer identity is recorded. Bills (bill_id) are the only stand-in for shoppers, but a bill does not identify a person, so repeat visits and churn cannot be measured.

Q009.cannot: No table links bills to a shopper identity; shopper identity is not recorded.

Q010.cannot: Customer satisfaction is not recorded. No table captures satisfaction scores, surveys, sentiment, or repeat-visit behavior. The nearest recorded evidence is complaints (customer-complaints-june) and payment failures (pos-payments-june), but these only show problems, not overall satisfaction.

Q011.cannot: No table contains a 'category' column or a mapping from the 11 tracked SKUs to a 'snacks' category. The products table lists 11 SKUs (atta, bread, curd, dal, milk, oil, rice, sugar) but none are classified as snacks, and no other table provides category information.

Q012.cannot: No product launch is recorded in the data. The tables cover only the eleven followed items for June 2026, with no product introduction dates, no 'new' flag, and no sales history before June to show a shift. Cannibalisation cannot be checked.

Q013.cannot: No record holds demand, lost sales, shopper preferences, competitor data, or margin after overheads. The eleven tracked products have sales and stock data, but range decisions need what is not recorded: true demand (including lost sales), shopper identity, full-store sales, and real margin.

Q014.cannot: No table records queue length, wait time, or till service duration. The records cover payments, bills, and sales lines, but not the time a shopper spends waiting before payment.

Q015.cannot: Diwali 2026 date is not in the recorded period (June 2026 only); no forward-looking sales data or demand model exists in the records

Q017.cannot: No table records shopper age or gender. Bills (pos-payments-june, pos-lines-may-june) are the nearest stand-in for shoppers, but they contain no demographic data.

Q018.cannot: No table records shopper requests for products the store does not stock. The records cover only the eleven followed items and their sales, stock, orders, deliveries, payments and complaints. There is no log of staff interactions or of products outside the eleven.
